name: 15178-prefillheavy-dsv2lite-1gpu
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite, bf16, ~31 GB of weights. The BASE checkpoint, not -Chat: the requests are raw text continuations.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP off. One GPU, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, 27 layers, MLA, 16 attention heads, hidden 2048, 26 MoE blocks of 64 routed + 2 shared experts at top-6, 15.7B total / 2.4B active. Geometry is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 4000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` over `/v1/completions`, single turn, no shared prefix -- ~2048 prompt tokens (stdev 256, 1024-3072) unique per request, ~16 generated (stdev 4, 8-32), `ignore_eos`, seed 42.
purpose: A text autocompletion service extending long unique documents into short continuations for 32 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The sglang server arguments for this item.

model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
trust-remote-code: true
tp-size: 1
attention-backend: fa3

# Declarations, not tuning knobs: every request is a cold, full-length prefill, prefilled in one
# piece. Changing either changes what is being measured.
disable-radix-cache: true
chunked-prefill-size: -1

max-prefill-tokens: 16384
# The checkpoint advertises 163840 positions via YaRN; the longest request here is 3072 + 32.
context-length: 4096
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42
